description: This PHP script generates a report of test cases that have not been executed on any platform within a test management system. It loads configuration, retrieves test plan and project info, processes test results, and builds a matrix or HTML table for display.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for various data structures in the script.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class for rendering an extended JavaScript table for results display.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: Class for rendering static HTML tables for results display.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine class used for rendering the report.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves input arguments for the script.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view test plan metrics.

methods.name: buildMatrix
methods.description: Builds a results matrix as either an ExtJS table or static HTML table.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Constructs email configuration for report distribution.
